notes.title: Two typing games + DLC in a bundle!

Including this title, two typing games and DLC produced by Yakuentei are now available in one bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43988

[h2]Note: Total amount displayed before adding to cart[/h2]

The total amount of this bundle displayed on Steam may NOT be subtracting the amount of items already purchased, but rather showing a higher amount that is the sum of all items. Once you add this bundle to your cart, they should be subtracted correctly. So, please confirm that the total amount is as intended before settlement.

notes.title: Price Revision (Students of Psionic Power & Students of Light Bonds)
notes.notes:
The price of Yakuentei Typing Game series (Students of Psionic Power & Students of Light Bonds) has been revised (price reduction).

[list]
[*]Students of Psionic Power : USD $7.99 => $3.99 (JPY ￥770 => ￥440)
[*]Students of Light Bonds : USD $7.99 => $6.99 (JPY ￥880 => ￥770)
[/list]

In order to avoid unfairness to those who purchased during the previous Steam Summer Sale, the new price is higher than the previous discounted price (based on USD and JPY).

The price revisions for other currencies are based on Steam's current regional pricing recommendations, so the range of the price revisions are different for each other. Thank you for your understanding.

Reference : About Steam recommended regional pricing (official article)
https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/pricing#5

notes.title: Steam Cloud Save is now supported!
notes.notes:
Steam Cloud Save feature is now supported!
(No changes in game application itself. Only added some settings to Steam system.)

Max 16 files, max 4096 bytes of save data files (*.dat) will be synchronized automatically.

If you would like to disable Steam Cloud feature, please right-click this game in Steam Client, and click "Property" to open the option settings dialog.

notes.title: "Hi-Res Character Creation DLC" has been released!
notes.notes:
As announced previous update information, Yakuentei has released "Hi-Res Character Creation DLC"!

Once you have purchased & installed Hi-Res Character Creation DLC additionally, you can take each character's photo into 2048x4096 pixels PNG file with transparency background.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251884/56f8d17da256401a8a04bf45915b7a848d17a51f.jpg[/img]

However, we must apologize for one thing to all of you.
[list]
[*][b][u]This DLC is NOT able to "purchase" on Steam.[/u][/b]
[/list]
It means that [b]you need to purchase this DLC via another download store as below, in order to use this DLC with Steam edition of this game.[/b][i] (the reason is also described as below)[/i]

[h1]Store site for this DLC[/h1]
It is available on "DLsite", which is a storefront service for indie (doujin) works in Japan.

Different from Steam, there is no client software for DLsite. So, if you have purchased this DLC on DLsite, you need to download an archive file (compressed in zip) manually, includes DLC file and some documents.

The store page's URL for this DLC in English version is following.
https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ01050744.html/?locale=en_US


[h1]Why this DLC is not available in Steam for purchasing?[/h1]
The reason is related to the [b]requirement of Steam refund for DLC.[/b]
For details, please see following URL's article.
https://ci-en.net/creator/14157/article/848669


[h1]How to install this DLC to Steam edition of this game?[/h1]
You need to install the DLC file (filename : HikariS_DLC) using Windows Explorer.

At first, please right-click "Students of Light Bonds" on your Steam client.
Next, point "Manage" and click "Browse local files".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251884/8f35deec72de12cf44449f4b83ffa58cb82887b5.png[/img]

Once Windows Exprorer has been opened, please move into the sub-folders : "HikariS_Data" => "StreamingAssets".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251884/63e83be0ff4c843b23423737c10482e6b28c9535.png[/img]

Finally, please overwrite original 0-byte "HikariS_DLC" file as a new one including in downloaded zip file from DLsite.

Please see also ReadMe.txt and etc. in downloaded zip file for more detail information, including operation check.

[h1]Attention for Steam software update[/h1]
[b][u]The "HikariS_DLC" file may be initialized (as 0 byte file) when "Steam Client" or "Students of Light Bonds" has been updated.[/u][/b]

So, please back-up your HikariS_DLC file on another folder or etc.
Sorry for the inconvenience.

(Note that you can re-download DLC file if you made your DLsite user account before purchase this DLC.)

notes.title: Students of Light Bonds v1.1 Update Information
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added feature for supporting "Hi-Res Character Creation DLC".
[*]Added version display on bottom-left of Title menu.
[*]Added Windows 11 to supported OS.
[/list]

[h1]About "Hi-Res Character Creation DLC"[/h1]
The DLC named "Hi-Res Character Creation DLC" will be released in the near future.
The main purpose of this update (v1.1) is in order to be able to recognize this DLC from this game application.

After purchased & installed this DLC, at the "Character Creation" menu in this game, you will be able to take each character's photo as a high resolution (2048x4096 pixels) PNG file with transparent background.

For details about this DLC (ex. how to purchase), we will post another information after finished releasing this DLC, which will be tagged (categorized) as "Cross Promotion".
